# ADS: Architecture Description Standard

> A free, open-source standard that prescribes the structure, content, and quality criteria of Solution Architecture Documents (SADs). Built upon ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010, the 4+1 View Model, the cloud Well-Architected Frameworks, and TOGAF. Backed by a formal JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) for machine validation and generation.

ADS defines which sections a SAD must contain, what each section must answer, and what "good" looks like at three documentation depths (Minimum / Recommended / Comprehensive — mapped to RFC 2119 SHALL / SHOULD / MAY). The current standard version is v1.3.3; the JSON Schema version is v1.0.0. Licensed under CC BY 4.0 (content) and MIT (code).

Three names appear throughout. **ADS** is this standard. **SAD** (Solution Architecture Document) is the document you produce. **HLD** (High Level Design) is the architectural-views and quality-attributes content within a SAD.

- [Why ADS?](https://archstandard.org/v1/standard/why-ads/): How ADS compares to ISO 42010, TOGAF, 4+1, AWS/Azure Well-Architected, arc42, and C4 — and why you might choose it.

## The Standard (Sections 0–7)

- [0. Document Control](https://archstandard.org/v1/standard/0-document-control/): Metadata, change history, contributors, and document purpose.
- [1-executive-summary](https://archstandard.org/v1/standard/1-executive-summary/): 
- [2-stakeholders](https://archstandard.org/v1/standard/2-stakeholders/): 
- [3. Architectural Views](https://archstandard.org/v1/standard/3-views-overview/): Overview of the architectural viewpoints used in this standard.
- [3-1-logical-view](https://archstandard.org/v1/standard/3-1-logical-view/): 
- [3-2-integration-view](https://archstandard.org/v1/standard/3-2-integration-view/):

- [3-5-security-view](https://archstandard.org/v1/standard/3-5-security-view/): 
- [3-6-scenarios](https://archstandard.org/v1/standard/3-6-scenarios/): 
- [4-quality-attributes-overview](https://archstandard.org/v1/standard/4-quality-attributes-overview/): 
- [4-1-operational-excellence](https://archstandard.org/v1/standard/4-1-operational-excellence/):

## Schema and Templates

- [JSON Schema (canonical)](https://archstandard.org/schema/v1.0.0/ads.schema.json): machine-readable contract, JSON Schema Draft 2020-12. Validate against this URL.
- [Markdown template](https://archstandard.org/v1/templates/sad-template.md)
- [YAML template](https://archstandard.org/v1/templates/sad-template.yaml)
- [JSON template](https://archstandard.org/v1/templates/sad-template.json)
- [Word template](https://archstandard.org/v1/templates/sad-template.docx)
- [Complete standard PDF](https://archstandard.org/v1/ads-standard-v1.pdf)
